name: dsh-session-title-context
description: Cordis plugin: session-title provider (v3) with settings-page control surface. v1.2: settings auto-save (debounced 600ms, serialized, no save button), redesigned settings UI, per-rule instant save with undo, invalid numeric input never persisted. Persisted in <DSH_HOME>/session-title.json.

dsh.description: 会话标题总结 v4.2：设置页改动即自动保存（防抖 600ms，串行落盘，无保存按钮）；标题栏保留「标题」纯重算按钮（点击即用当前会话模型重生成，行内提示结果，无展开设置）；v1.2.1 修复窄面板文本溢出重叠与 HMR 样式竞态。

author: ExNeo
